title: Who made This?
description: A useless mod that literally credits the author in the console every 2 seconds and in-game at the bottom right of your screen is a message saying credit to the author, otherwise the mod does nothing
body: This is a mod that literally adds **credits** to the author for _no reason_ in the console, and adds a text overlay into the game when you join a singleplayer world / server. This basically covers the entire mod's purpose!
